title: What's Your Halloween Aesthetic?
description: Answer 12 questions to discover your Halloween aesthetic — from Victorian mourning and cottagegoth to spooky cute and vampire royalty.

questions.text: You're decorating for October. First purchase?

options.text: A first-edition gothic novel for the nightstand
A fog machine powerful enough to concern the neighbors
The same heirloom pumpkin ceramic I use every year
A cursed-looking antique mirror nobody can explain

questions.text: Your ideal Halloween night has a strict… what?

options.text: Budget. Beauty doesn't need chaos.
Emotional arc — everyone leaves feeling something
Itinerary. Dinner, haunt, cider, home by 11.
Schedule? My nights are improvisational jazz.

questions.text: Pick a color palette for the whole season:

options.text: Black, oxblood, and candle wax — alone, ideally
Every color, all at once, preferably glittering
Orange, cream, and harvest gold, like the classics
Iridescent oil-slick colors with no name yet

questions.text: Someone calls your decor 'too much'. You respond:

options.text: Present a structured three-point counter-argument
Hand them a cupcake and invite them closer
Politely ignore them; tradition speaks for itself
Add twice as much purely out of principle
A solo rainy-day film marathon with no messages
A road trip with four friends and a haunted corn maze
Apple picking, baking, the exact same cozy routine
Getting lost in a foggy town with no plan
A silver pocket watch, annoyingly precise
A locket with someone else's photo inside
The heirloom brooch I wear every single October
A ring that glows and I refuse to explain

questions.text: At the costume party you're mostly found…

options.text: In a corner having one excellent conversation
On the table, somehow, with a chandelier moment
Critiquing the structural integrity of every costume
Helping the host fix the makeup situation

questions.text: Your social calendar in October looks like:

options.text: Curated. Two events. Both chosen very carefully.
Ink black. There is no free weekend and I love it
The annual traditions, same people, same order
Whatever the group needs, I'll be there with cider

questions.text: Your Halloween music playlist is mostly…

options.text: Organ sonatas and film scores, enjoyed through headphones
A Halloween party playlist with a 200-person dance floor
The Monster Mash and other certified classics
Anything that makes my people laugh-sing along

questions.text: Pick a setting that feels like home in October:

options.text: A used bookstore with a basement and no signage
A rooftop ritual under a full moon
A perfectly run historic house tour
An abandoned fairground at dusk, trespassing-adjacent

questions.text: How should a Halloween party actually end?

options.text: With the last details cleaned up before midnight
With a séance that may or may not be real
On the scheduled end time, thank you very much
When the sun comes up, nobody remembers how

questions.text: Your approach to pumpkin carving is…

options.text: An architecturally precise design, measured twice
A surreal cosmic pumpkin that judges you gently
Traditional triangle face, executed flawlessly
Freestyle, no stencil, whatever the pumpkin tells me

results.title: Dark Academia Gothic
results.description: Candlelit libraries, velvet blazers, annotated poetry, and a glass of something red. Your Halloween lives in old stone halls where every shadow has a footnote — moody, intellectual, and immaculately curated.

results.title: Cabinet of Curiosities
results.description: Taxidermy, brass instruments, labeled jars, and conspiracy boards strung with red thread. Your aesthetic is part museum, part mad laboratory — endlessly analytical and gloriously strange.

results.title: Vampire Royalty
results.description: Black silk, gold signet rings, high collars, and old money drama. You don't do Halloween small: you do candlelit ballrooms, string quartets, and the kind of glamour that makes people bow before you speak.

results.title: Kitsch Crypt
results.description: Plastic skeletons in sunglasses, hooting animatronic owls, orange string lights, and zero shame. You know 'good taste' is optional and fun is mandatory — your crypt looks like a Halloween store threw a rave.

results.title: Moonlit Mystic
results.description: Silver jewelry, fog, tarot spreads at midnight, and curtains that never quite open. You move through October like you share a secret with the moon — serene, intuitive, and faintly magical.

results.title: Cottagegoth
results.description: Black roses in chipped teacups, dried herbs, hand-knit shawls, and a cozy kind of melancholy. You prove that mourning attire and fresh-baked bread pair beautifully — soft, romantic, and deeply at home in October.

results.title: Coven Matriarch
results.description: Deep jewel tones, ritual candles arranged in perfect circles, and a dining table full of people who call you first. Your aesthetic is power with hospitality — commanding, warm, and slightly witchy in the best way.

results.title: Spooky Cute
results.description: Pastel goth, plush bats, pink skulls, and ghosts with bow ties. Why be scary when you can be adorable? You weaponize cuteness, collect themed mugs, and make Halloween feel like a sleepover.

results.title: Victorian Mourning
results.description: Black lace, jet beads, high collars, and etiquette intact. You treat Halloween like a period drama — precise, graceful, and committed to the craftsmanship of a more dramatic century.

results.title: Folk Horror Prairie
results.description: Linen dresses, corn dollies, wilted wheat, and the quiet dread of village rituals. Your Halloween feels ancient and sun-bleached — beautiful on the surface, unsettling underneath.

results.title: Old Hollywood Horror
results.description: Red lipstick, tailored capes, silver-screen eyeliner, and one perfectly positioned candelabra. You take the goth canon and give it star treatment — commanding, polished, and made for an entrance.

results.title: Patchwork Pumpkin
results.description: Gingham, friendly ghosts, painted pumpkins, and a porch that smells like cinnamon. Your Halloween is the whole neighborhood's happy place — nostalgic, generous, and designed for family photos.

results.title: Industrial Nightmare
results.description: Leather, neon, cracked screens, and bass you feel in your ribs. Your Halloween runs on strobe lights and controlled chaos — technical, sharp-edged, and built after dark.

results.title: Ethereal Ghost
results.description: White lace, pale silk, bare feet, and dry ice for everyday ambience. You look like you stepped out of a pre-Raphaelite haunting — delicate, artful, and quietly mesmerizing.

results.title: Punk Horror
results.description: Battle jackets, safety pins, fake blood, and slasher-movie patches. Your Halloween has a bassline and an attitude problem — loud, fast, and entirely unafraid of the dark.

results.title: Glitter Ghoul
results.description: Sequined monster masks, platform boots, body glitter, and a fog machine at the club. You believe Halloween is a performance art and the crowd is your cast — glamorous, loud, impossible to miss.

share_hook: There are 16 Halloween aesthetics hiding in October, and most people are dressing like the wrong one. Which one actually matches your soul?
